Pictures of you wrapped in a towel, of your chest, of your thighs—offering only the slightest glimpses of what you knew Henry wanted to see.

- ***There will be a car outside in 5.***
- ***Get in.***

You knew better than to not get in that car.

"You're late." he began, sitting back on his chair with a hand restig on his desk. "Take a seat."

You moved to sit down on the chair across for him, holding your breath—

"Tsk, tsk," he clicked his tongue, patting his thigh. "Not the chair, sweetheart. You know better than that."
